device.description: 14-bit 2 MSPS dual-channel single-ended SAR ADC with SPI interface
device.note: ads7946.pdf (SBAS539B) p.2 family, p.4 DVDD 1.65 V to AVDD and AVDD 2.7-5.25 V, p.7 timing diagram and Table 1 (tD1 14.5 ns, tD2 11 ns, tD3 15 ns at DVDD 1.8 V; tCONV 16 SCLK), p.8-9 pin configuration and functions, p.25 CH SEL (Figure 77), p.27-28 transfer function, p.29 16-/32-clock frames, p.30 conversion abort and power-down

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the CH SEL pin level (low = channel 0, high = channel 1)

pages: p.2 (family), p.4 (supplies), p.7 (timing, Table 1), p.8-9 (pins), p.25 (CH SEL), p.27-28 (code format), p.29-30 (frames, PDEN)
notModeled: analog inputs, reference and multiplexer settling; conversion is clocked by SCLK (16 SCLK, not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)
16-clock frame pipelining (SDO shows sample N-1 while converting sample N): the 0 V code is constant, so the output is the same
bits after D0 in the 16-clock frame are undefined in the datasheet (shown as don't-care); modeled as 0
32-clock frame mode (CS held low to the 30th SCLK falling edge: the next frame outputs 16 zeros, then the data of the current sample)
PDEN auto power-down (PDEN high at the CS rising edge powers the device down after the conversion; CS rising with PDEN low wakes it): PDEN is an input with no effect
conversion abort (CS high during the first 16 clocks invalidates the next frame's data)
throughput, acquisition time and SCLK frequency limits
variants: ADS7945 (differential AIN0P/AIN0N/AIN1N/AIN1P, twos complement, bipolar +/-VREF) and ADS7946 (single-ended AIN0/AIN0GND/AIN1GND/AIN1, straight binary) share ads7946.pdf; pin-compatible with the 12/10/8-bit ADS7947/8/9 (ads7947.pdf)
